claims.claim: Source-REPAIR bundles now use a deterministic, fixed-length repository-owned digest locator. The full repair_dispatch_id and complete intent remain in intent.json.
Existing exact transport and target validation remains in place. The tests cover distinct dispatch IDs and rejection when different exact intents are forced onto one locator.
The commit changes only src/aios_renew/operator.py and tests/test_operator.py. Staging retains its single real Git clone and detach checkout, with no host configuration or launcher changes.

The two affected tests now use a depth-amplified repository path where the former checkout location exceeds 260 characters. The complete consumer test covers staging, transport validation, detached checkout, replay, and target-side consumption.
